title: GCP Custom VPC Network Template
description: Configurable GCP Virtual Private Cloud with regional public and private subnetworks, Cloud NAT egress, and deny-by-default firewall rules

gcp_project_id.title: GCP Project ID
gcp_project_id.description: GCP project ID where network resources will be created

environment_name.title: Environment Name
environment_name.description: Identifier prefix applied to all VPC networking resources

region.title: GCP Region
region.description: GCP region where the network resources will be deployed

public_subnet_cidr.title: Public Subnet CIDR
public_subnet_cidr.description: CIDR range for the public (workload-facing) subnetwork

private_subnet_cidr.title: Private Subnet CIDR
private_subnet_cidr.description: CIDR range for the private (database / internal) subnetwork

enable_private_nat.title: NAT Only Private Subnet
enable_private_nat.description: Route only the private subnet through Cloud NAT (true) or all subnetworks (false)

allowed_ssh_cidrs.title: Allowed SSH CIDRs
allowed_ssh_cidrs.description: Permitted IPv4 network blocks for SSH administrative access. Empty list disables inbound SSH.
